changes.title: Graham Platner officially files letter withdrawing candidacy
changes.summary: Graham Platner, who was the Democratic candidate for Senate in Maine, officially filed a letter withdrawing his candidacy following rape allegations which he denies. The filing triggers a process where the Maine Democratic Party can replace him on the ballot.

changes.title: Graham Platner makes it official in Maine, submitting paperwork to leave Senate race
changes.summary: In his withdrawal notice, Platner said "people are desperate for change" and that's why they made him the Democratic nominee. Now, Maine Democrats have to pick someone to replace him by July 27. (Image credit: CJ Gunther).

changes.title: The Platner Drama Is Reviving Debate Among Democrats Over a Double Standard
changes.summary: His candidacy stoked tensions among Democrats over gender and how to win back working-class voters.

changes.title: Product availability changed in Europe
changes.summary: The last-minute scramble to name a replacement reminds some in the party of the challenges they faced in 2024.

changes.title: How American Socialism Changed, and Stormed the Democratic Party
changes.summary: The movement was better at critiquing the system than reshaping it. But it has never had this much mainstream political power.
